diseases.name: Blast (Jhulsa Rog)
diseases.organic_remedy: Spray neem oil (5ml per litre water) every 7 days. Use Trichoderma viride as soil treatment. Remove infected leaves immediately.
diseases.hindi_remedy: Neem tel ka ghol (5ml per litre paani) 7 din mein ek baar spray karein. Trichoderma viride mitti mein milaein. Sankramit patte turant hatayein.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew (Safed Churn Rog)
diseases.organic_remedy: Mix 1 tbsp baking soda + 1 tsp neem oil in 1 litre water. Spray weekly. Use wood ash on affected areas.
diseases.hindi_remedy: 1 chamach baking soda + 1 chamach neem tel ek litre paani mein milakar weekly spray karein. Prabhavit jagah par lakdi ki raakh chirakein.

diseases.name: Root Rot (Jadon Sarana)
diseases.organic_remedy: Improve drainage. Apply Trichoderma harzianum to soil. Use curd water (diluted whey) as soil drench. Avoid overwatering.
diseases.hindi_remedy: Pani nikasi theek karein. Trichoderma harzianum mitti mein milaein. Chaach ka paani (diluted) mitti mein dalein. Zyada paani dene se bachein.

diseases.name: Aphids (Maahu)
diseases.organic_remedy: Spray diluted neem oil (2%). Use garlic-chilli spray. Introduce ladybugs naturally. Use yellow sticky traps.
diseases.hindi_remedy: Neem tel (2%) ka spray karein. Lehsun-mirch ka ghol spray karein. Peele chipchipe trap lagaein.

diseases.name: Leaf Borer (Patton ka Keeda)
diseases.organic_remedy: Use Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) spray. Apply neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%). Light traps at night. Intercrop with repellent plants.
diseases.hindi_remedy: Bt spray ka istemal karein. Neem beej ka sat (NSKE 5%) spray karein. Raat ko light trap lagaein.

diseases.name: Fruit Borer (Fal ka Keeda)
diseases.organic_remedy: Spray NSKE (Neem Seed Kernel Extract) 5%. Use pheromone traps. Remove and destroy infected fruits. Spray Spinosad (organic).
diseases.hindi_remedy: NSKE 5% spray karein. Pheromone trap lagaein. Sankramit fal turant hatakr nasht karein.

jeevamrit_recipe.name: Jeevamrit
ingredients: 10 kg fresh desi cow dung (gaay ka gobar)
Handful of soil from banyan tree base
jeevamrit_recipe.method: Mix all in a barrel, stir twice daily, ready in 48 hours. Use within 7 days.
jeevamrit_recipe.hindi_method: Sab ek barrel mein milaein, din mein 2 baar hilaein, 48 ghante mein taiyar. 7 din mein use karein.
jeevamrit_recipe.usage: Dilute 200 litres with 200 litres water, spray or irrigate per acre
